local: Que á la Patria feliz encamina;
english: Liberty, Liberty is the cry
That leads to a happy country;
Liberty is the divine star
Light of glory of the faithful Savior.

local: De los libres un canto bendito:
Se rindió de la vil opresion.
english: In the blissful homeland resounds
A blessed song of the free:
She never, to the cursed stigma
Of vile oppression, surrendered.

local: De la Union en la pléyade bella
english: Joyfully beholding, in Heaven
Her splendid star raised,
From the Union in the beautiful Pleiad
She will give admiration to the worlds.
She resolved her happiness to work
Because she does not consent to live a slave;
Liberty is her shining stamp
Liberty her flag and honour.

local: Y sus hijos, sus bravos soldados;
Para gloria mayor de sus leyes
El poder condenó de los reyes......
¡Que es la Ley su absoluto señor!
english: And her children, her brave soldiers;
For the greater glory of her laws
She doomed the power of the kings......
Because the Law is her absolute lord!

local: Dulce Patria, con solo un matiz;
La Igualdad en tu suelo creció.
english: Just enclose your bosom, democrats
Sweet Fatherland, with just one nuance;
You freely breathe happily
Equality grew on your soil.

local: Todo un Dios que te brinda la suerte
english: The generous extends his hand to you
And calls you a strong Republic,
A true God who provides you fortune
All the goods the earth created.

local: Si los pueblos de América un dia
Bajo el yugo de Iberia gimieron,
Héroes tuvo que al fin sacudieron
De su frente tan torpe baldon.
english: If the peoples of America one day
Moaned under the yoke of Iberia,
Heroes had to finally shake off
From their forehead such a clumsy disgrace.

local: Y resuene en las altas montañas
El placer de esta libre Nacion.
english: Let us honour their memory surrendered
Let us acclaim their glories and deeds,
And let resonate in the high mountains
The pleasure of this free Nation.
